definitions.explanation: A state of well-being and contentment.

examples.japanese: {幸|しあわ}せな⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧
{幸|しあわ}せ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{願|ねが}う→願う：02387_negau⟧。
⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦とき→時：02918_toki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧{幸|しあわ}せ⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I'm happiest when I'm with my family.

examples.english: I'm fortunate to have met you.

examples.english: There was a big earthquake, but it was a blessing that the whole family was safe.

notes:
{幸|しあわ}せ functions as both a noun (happiness) and a na-adjective (happy). A fundamental word for expressing well-being and contentment.

FORMS:
- Na-adjective: {幸|しあわ}せ⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a happy person)
- Adverbial: {幸|しあわ}せ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧ (to live happily)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{幸|しあわ}せ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: Best wishes! (said at weddings)
- {幸|しあわ}せ⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧: lucky person
- {幸|しあわ}せ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel happiness
- {幸|しあわ}せ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become happy

WRITING:
- {幸|しあわ}せ (standard)
- {仕合|しあわ}せ (archaic/literary)

RELATED WORDS:
⟦{幸|さいわ}い→幸い：02774_saiwai⟧ is a related word meaning "fortunately" (adverb) or "good fortune" (noun), but uses a different reading.
